author: brandons209
install_msg: Thank you for installing my cog! To get started, run [p]watchlist
name: Watchlist
short: Watch for user's joining your guild and get notified when they join/leave.
description: Allows guild staff to better keep track of persons of interest both inside and outside of their guild.
end_user_data_statement: This cog store's users ids of those added to the watchlist for each guild.
